voice.conversationWelcomeSubtitle: Choose Codex or Claude. Sign-in stays inside the official CLI OAuth flow; then Jester can finish the rest of The Fool setup with you.

voice.conversationUnattendedOnHint: A spoken task carries on by itself. It cannot ask you to confirm — there is no window in front of you to answer in.
voice.conversationUnattendedOffHint: A task that needs confirmation waits in its own chat until you open it and answer.
voice.conversationHoldToTalkOnHint: Right Ctrl held opens the microphone; it is shut the rest of the time, so nothing you did not say can be heard.
voice.conversationHoldToTalkOffHint: Always listening. A keystroke or a fan can still be heard as a sentence and answered.

overview.title: Overview

memory.title: Memory
memory.subtitle: What The Fool remembers about you, and what it has learned about working for you. Both files are read before every conversation, and by any agent working on your behalf.
memory.userHint: Who you are, what to call you, what your own words mean, and a line about each conversation. Every line is yours to correct.
memory.agentHint: Lessons taken from what went wrong, and the ways of doing things you have taught out loud. Edit anything here.
memory.placeholder: Nothing remembered yet. Write whatever you want known, or just start talking.
memory.skillsHint: Things you taught The Fool to do by itself. Each one runs the moment you say it — no agent, nothing to wait for. Delete any you did not mean to teach.
memory.skillsEmpty: Nothing taught yet. Tell it about something in a conversation — a song, a page, a program — and it will be here.

layout.title: Layout
layout.subtitle: A theme decides what the app is coloured like everywhere. This decides what one window is shaped like — so you can keep your colours and still change the voice page from a column into a dial.
layout.saveHint: Give it a name to keep these settings and put them on.
layout.editHint: Change anything above, then save it under a name of your own.

tokenHint.radius: How round every corner is. Zero is square.
tokenHint.textScale: Everything sized in relative units follows.
tokenHint.motionMs: How long a transition takes. Zero is instant.
tokenHint.accent: How far your accent colour reaches.
tokenHint.contrast: How far a panel stands off the page.

layout.previewBody: Everything here wears what the sliders say, before you save it.

motion.title: Movement
motion.subtitle: Build a movement by choosing, not by writing CSS. Pick what moves, how it arrives and how fast; watch it, then add it.

hub.title: Fool's Hub
hub.subtitle: A workspace is the whole app aimed at one thing — the layout, who the assistant is being, which agent and model do the work. Arrange it once, name it, and it is one click or one sentence from then on.
hub.makeTitle: Make one from how things are now
hub.makeHint: This takes the app exactly as you have it arranged — layout, persona, agent and model — and keeps it under a name.
